title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of the first circle centered at coordinates [0.035, 0.035] with a radius of 0.035. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0699 to adjust its size. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it according to the specified Euler angles and translating it using the specified translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. Ensure that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.06990302809090967 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
sketch = workplane.center(0.035, 0.035).circle(0.035)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.035, 0.035)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.035)         # Draw a circle with radius 0.035
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)         # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder of height 0.75
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
